home.title: The AI Congress
home.description: A revolutionary system for scientific article review using generative AI.
home.benefitsTitle: How Can The AI Congress Help You?
home.benefitsDescription: Our system uses generative AI to simplify article reviews:
home.benefit1: Initial article assessment by generative AI.
home.benefit3: Reviewer assignment based on article keywords.
home.benefit4: Efficient tools for review and feedback.
home.howItWorksTitle: How Does The AI Congress Work?
home.howItWorksStep1: You submit your article in LaTeX project format (ZIP).
home.howItWorksStep2: Our system processes the content for further steps.
home.howItWorksStep3: We generate an automatic summary of your article with generative AI.
home.howItWorksStep4: We perform an initial assessment using generative AI.
home.howItWorksStep5: The article is assigned to an expert reviewer.
home.howItWorksStep6: The reviewer receives the article and AI insights for evaluation.
home.howItWorksStep7: The reviewer approves, rejects, or requests improvements.
